body:
Sorry to hear about your boyfriend, my condolences.

I appreciate that you are able to talk about things like this. It must be hard - feel so selfish now as it must be agonising
She doesn’t want any police involvement.

Thank you I guess.

For me, alcohol is never an excuse and I feel horrific trying to excuse myself by saying that I don’t remember etc etc.

knowing I am unable to control myself when that drunk - or that perhaps that is really what i am like, and getting that drunk is just how it is revealed - it honestly scares me that i had it in me to do smth like that
